tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently started a new job on campus and have been assigned a mentor, Ms. Johnson, who has given you valuable guidance and advice. You want to express your appreciation. Write an email to Ms. Johnson.
bullets: Describe specific ways her mentorship has helped you.
Tell her which piece of advice was the most helpful to you and explain why.
Ask for suggestions on how to improve your performance.
tasks.subject: Internship Mentor Thank-you
